stories.title: No. 1 Florida and No. 3 UConn both lost for the first time on the same night
stories.dek: No. 8 Houston beat Florida 86-76 and No. 12 Arizona beat UConn 85-79, the only 2 ranked-vs-ranked games of the night.

stories.title: Andrej Stojakovic scored 46 at Duke, the most ever by a visitor at Cameron
stories.dek: The 46 broke a 69-year-old record and ended Duke's 35-game home winning streak.
stories.hero_stat: 46 points — the most ever by an opponent at Cameron Indoor

stories.title: No. 14 Tennessee held No. 2 Michigan State to 9 made field goals
stories.dek: The Spartans shot 18 percent — the first Top 20 team under 10 makes in 77 years.
stories.hero_stat: 9 field goals — Michigan State's fewest in a Top 20 game in 77 years

stories.title: Memphis beat No. 10 Louisville by 20 — the widest ranked loss this season
stories.dek: The Tigers are 2-1 against ranked teams, and ranked teams are now 78-3 against unranked opponents.

stories.title: LSU ended Gonzaga's 21-game home win streak, 81-80
stories.dek: The unranked Tigers beat No. 14 Gonzaga in Spokane, the Zags' first home loss since February 2025.
stories.hero_stat: 81-80 — LSU ends Gonzaga's 21-game home win streak

stories.title: Jeremy Fears Jr. scored a season-high 24 with 9 assists and 0 turnovers
stories.dek: Fears leads Division I at 10.0 assists per game; Michigan State made a season-high 18 3-pointers in the 106-72 win over Northern Iowa.

stories.title: Kentucky survived winless Northern Arizona 78-77, the closest ranked game yet
stories.dek: Northern Arizona shot 13 of 26 on 3-pointers and led for 41% of the game; no Wildcat scored more than 14 points.
stories.hero_stat: 78-77, the only 1-possession game in 80 ranked-team games

stories.title: No. 5 Michigan State held No. 2 Duke to 73 points on 33% shooting
stories.dek: Duke averaged 98.5 points on 55% shooting in its first 2 games; Michigan State led wire to wire.
